title: Kooky Bitter French Refried Beans Casserole
description: A bitter and springy French dish featuring refried beans, this casserole is perfect for adventurous eaters, and is satvik-friendly as it contains no animal products or by-products.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced bitter melon and cook until it is tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked bitter melon mixture, refried beans, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, toss the cubed whole wheat bread with a little bit of olive oil and toast in the oven until crispy.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the bread cubes.
Add a layer of the refried bean mixture on top of the bread cubes.
Sprinkle the shredded vegetarian cheese over the top of the casserole.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
